summary: Verified marquee GPU-layer flicker fix and MTV logo enlargement on ACID one-page site. All assertions pass: .track has will-change:transform + backface-visibility:hidden and is animating; all 6 expected brand logos load as with naturalWidth>0; MTV=50px, Land Rover=72px, Tajín=46px, others=30px. Text-fallback brands (Club Pachuca, BAMX, Catal 1.5°T, Zoebisch) render as as expected. Routes /, /aviso-de-privacidad, /aviso-legal return 200. Mobile hamburger menu opens/closes at 375px. Nav anchors render at 1440px.
critical_code_review_comments: 8 console 404s for /public/logos/pachuca|bamx|catal|zoebisch SVGs are expected fallbacks but produce noisy console errors on every page load. Consider preflighting the URL list (or catching in onError silently) so DevTools stays clean.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Assertions verified via getComputedStyle on .track (willChange='transform', backfaceVisibility='hidden'), transform matrix delta over 800ms confirmed animation. Brand images verified via document.querySelector('img.brand-logo[alt="<name>"]') naturalWidth>0 and computed height. MTV enlarged from 30->50px confirmed.
rca of the issue: N/A - fix applied by main agent verified working.
